paper.title_en: $K_1^*(1870)$ and $3S$-$2D$ mixing in the strange meson sector
paper.abstract_en: Very recently, the BESIII Collaboration reported the first observation of a $J^P=1^-$ strange resonance in the $Kη'$ system, the $K_1^*(1870)$. We examine whether this state can be accommodated in the kaon meson family. Although it cannot be assigned as a pure $3^3S_1$ or $2^3D_1$ state, we show that it can be described as the lower state of $3S$-$2D$ mixing, whose mass agrees with the measured value, and we predict its higher-mass partner. Using the quark pair creation model, we calculate the OZI-allowed decay properties of both \textcolor{black}{mixed} states; the total decay width of the lower state is consistent with the measured width of the $K_1^*(1870)$. We note that the subordinate $Kη'$ decay mode of this state appears to contradict its observed $Kη'$ decay channel, which calls for further study. We further investigate the production of these two states via the $Kp$ reaction, which may provide valuable information for future experimental searches.
